# Architecture Template

Version: 0.1.0  
Status: Template  
Last Updated: 2026-07-27

## Purpose

Describe the architectural decision, subsystem, or component.

## Scope

Define what is included and excluded.

## Responsibilities

List the responsibilities of this architecture area.

## Inputs

Define all inputs and dependencies.

## Outputs

Define all outputs and side effects.

## Data Flow

Describe the data flow.

## Failure Modes

Describe expected failure cases and fail-safe behavior.

## Testing Requirements

Define required tests.

## Open Questions

List unresolved decisions.
